name: ceo-inbox-download-attachment
description: Download an email attachment from the CEO's personal inbox by its Nylas attachment ID. Returns base64-encoded file content ready to pass directly to file-parse. Use ceo-inbox-read first to find attachment IDs. Enforces a 10 MB size limit.

inputs.attachment_id: string (Nylas attachment ID from ceo-inbox-read's attachments array)
inputs.message_id: string (Nylas message ID the attachment belongs to)

outputs.content_base64: string (base64-encoded file content, ready to pass to file-parse)
